systematicExtractionGaps: The requested data/agent_library/README.md, manifest.json, and proposal-template.json files are absent from current main (404), so the existing S6 retained proposal structure was used as the compatibility contract.

Current data/google_inventory_detail_evidence.json is empty even though the current batch plan reports featuredDishesKnown for several shard-0 rows. For those rows, derived coverage counts cannot substitute for source-native names/provenance, so they are blocked rather than reconstructed.

Several exact retained Tabelog rows contain identity/cuisine/budget/hours data and even an empty dishes array, but their sourceRefs do not claim dishes. Under build_retained_dish_evidence.mjs these are correctly no_evidence, not F.

Some batch-plan rows report retained third-party source coverage but the exact source-enrichment record is not safely recoverable through the current repository code index. Those rows remain blocked rather than using cuisine, name, reviews, or nearby restaurants.

Current representative featured-dish patches are not strict recommendation evidence by themselves. All directly recovered ordinary menu items remain F unless explicit recommendation/signature/popular semantics is retained.
